import sys, requests
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import field_motion_common as fc

WMS_BASE = fc.WMS_BASE
min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat = fc.WEST_BBOX
bbox = f"{min_lon},{min_lat},{max_lon},{max_lat}"
TS = "2026-08-18T04:45:00.000Z"

for layer in ["msg_fes:clm", "msg_fes:cth"]:
    params = {
        "service": "WMS", "version": "1.3.0", "request": "GetMap",
        "layers": layer, "styles": "", "crs": "CRS:84",
        "bbox": bbox, "width": fc.TILE_SIZE, "height": fc.TILE_SIZE,
        "format": "image/png", "transparent": "true", "time": TS,
    }
    try:
        r = requests.get(WMS_BASE, params=params, timeout=15)
        ctype = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
        print(f"LAYER={layer} STATUS={r.status_code} CTYPE={ctype!r} LEN={len(r.content)}")
        if "image" not in ctype:
            print("  BODY_SNIPPET:", r.content[:400])
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"LAYER={layer} EXCEPTION: {e}")
PYEND
